    Search concepts within one vocabulary

    Source: R/api.R
    skosmos_vocabulary_search.Rd

    Uses the vocabulary-specific Skosmos search route. This is convenient when the vocabulary is already known and avoids passing vocabs separately.

    Usage

    skosmos_vocabulary_search(
  client,
  vocid,
  query,
  lang = NULL,
  labellang = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  parent = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  maxhits = 100,
  offset = 0,
  fields = NULL,
  unique = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    client

    A skosmos_client created with skosmos_client().

    vocid

    A single vocabulary identifier.

    query

    Search expression.

    lang

    Optional language of the search query.

    labellang

    Optional preferred language for returned labels.

    type

    Optional resource-type filter.

    parent

    Optional parent concept URI filter.

    group

    Optional concept-group URI filter.

    maxhits

    Maximum number of requested hits.

    offset

    Number of matching records to skip.

    fields

    Optional character vector of fields requested from Skosmos.

    unique

    Logical; request unique results where supported.

    Value

    A tibble of matching concepts.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
finto <- skosmos_client("https://api.finto.fi/rest/v1/")
skosmos_vocabulary_search(
  finto,
  vocid = "yso",
  query = "forest",
  lang = "en",
  maxhits = 10
)
} # }
